name: India FMCG KPI Panel
citation: Adak, S. MMM Weekly Data - Geo:India (synthetic FMCG Geo×SKU×week panel). Kaggle dataset subhagatoadak/mmm-weekly-data-geoindia (https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/subhagatoadak/mmm-weekly-data-geoindia). Primary file used: synthetic_mmm_weekly_india.csv (largest CSV in the zip; companion synthetic_mmm_weekly_india_SAT.csv also present).
license: Apache License 2.0 (as reported by the Kaggle dataset download metadata for subhagatoadak/mmm-weekly-data-geoindia).
description: National MMM panel. This bundle jointly forecasts `sales_value`, `display_flag_adstock`, `trade_spend_adstock`, `tv_impressions_adstock`, `youtube_impressions_adstock`, `cpi`. Source: Kaggle synthetic MMM Weekly Data - Geo:India — weekly after national rollup, 155 rows, 2022-07-04..2025-06-16. Windows: context_window=52, forecast_horizon=8. Classic marketing-mix setup with geometric adstock (decay=0.2) and CPI macros.
preprocessing: 1. download_mmm_india.py: `python -m kaggle datasets download -d subhagatoadak/mmm-weekly-data-geoindia -p data/marketing/mmm_india/raw --unzip`; write schema manifest.
2. transform_mmm_india.py: choose largest CSV (synthetic_mmm_weekly_india.csv); snake_case columns.
3. Parse Week → UTC week-start timestamps (W-MON); rename sales column → sales_value.
4. Auto-detect numeric media/spend columns via name hints (tv, facebook, youtube, instagram, print, radio, display, trade, impression, spend, …).
5. National aggregation by timestamps: SUM sales_value + all spend/impression columns across Geo×Brand×SKU; macros (cpi, gdp, …) take FIRST per week (not summed).
6. Geometric adstock on each spend-like column: adstock_t = X_t + 0.2 * adstock_{t-1}; emit {col}_adstock. No Hill/log saturation.
7. Complete weekly index min→max; fill missing sales/spend with 0; ffill/bfill macros; assert ≥61 weeks.
8. Observed output: 155 weeks (2022-07-04..2025-06-16); adstock channels include display_flag, trade_spend, tv/youtube/facebook/instagram impressions, print_readership, radio_listenership.
9. build_tasks.py: univariate/multivariate/covariate TempusBench CSVs (context_window=52, forecast_horizon=8). ISLR Advertising.csv intentionally excluded.
